question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
​The correct answer is '**prompted**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about the 'Marie Curie'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**prompted**'.
 
• It means 'to cause something to happen; to make somebody decide to do something'. (कुछ होने का कारण बनना; किसी को कोई निर्णय लेने के लिए प्रेरित करना)
 
 
• *Example: What **prompted** you to give up your job?*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
